title: Harmony checker for hill-climbing
description: A validation tool the agent runs after every edit to climb toward music that isn't discordant: per-track stems, an interval-clash kernel (pairwise and against the chord, with the bass emphasized), one objective with guards against gaming it, and actionable findings. Design: ~/.claude/plans/system-reminder-you-are-operating-async-starfish.md. It came from the Ave House demo, where the chord-tone share looked fine while the user heard discord: A held a semitone above a Bb bass.
